applies: Title 18-C (Maine Uniform Probate Code), effective 2019-09-01 — see transition_18a.

governing.title: Duty of personal representative; supplementary inventory
governing.why: Supplementary inventory when new assets surface or values change.

considerations.title: Employment of appraisers
considerations.note: Appraisers may be employed to value items; identify them.

considerations.title: Duty of personal representative; inventory and appraisal
considerations.note: Net value (gross less encumbrances) is the inventory's bottom line.

considerations.title: Duty of personal representative; inventory and appraisal
considerations.note: Real property is inventoried at date-of-death value with encumbrances shown.

transition_18a: Title 18-C applies to estates of decedents who die on or after 2019-09-01, and to any proceeding pending on or commenced after that date. For a decedent who died before 2019-09-01, former Title 18-A supplies the substantive succession rules even though the proceeding itself runs under 18-C. See _index/18a-key-diffs.json (governing rule: 18-C §8-301).
